description:
🚀 Team ADECCE – Galactic Ace

We are three middle-school students and our teacher mentor from Özel Antalya Yükseliş Koleji, Antalya, Türkiye, working on the Space Mission Design Game challenge.

Galactic Ace is a 3D Unity game: players design their own spacecraft within a budget and a mass limit, then fly missions to 22 Solar System destinations (planets, dwarf planets and moons) and learn real space science along the way.
